questions.q: The Son is shown to be better than whom in this chapter?
What did God appoint his Son to be?

When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, Let all the angels of God ____.
He makes his angels winds, and his servants ____.
Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with ____ above your fellows.

items: You are my Son, today I have become your father
Your throne, O God, is forever
You laid the foundation of the earth
Sit at my right hand

questions.q: The chapter calls angels serving spirits sent out for those who will inherit salvation.
The chapter says the heavens will never grow old, just as the Lord continues.
What might happen if we don't pay greater attention to what we heard?
What kind of high priest did Jesus become by being made like his brothers?
options: A merciful and faithful high priest
A righteous and holy high priest
A gentle and humble high priest
A great and eternal high priest

questions.q: How did God testify along with those who first heard the message?
options: Signs, wonders, works of power, gifts of the Spirit

questions.q: Rather than angels, whom does Jesus give help to?
How will we escape if we neglect ____?
You made him ____. You crowned him with glory and honor.
questions.answer: a little lower than the angels

questions.q: In bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation ____.

items: The world to come is not subject to angels
What is man, that you think of him?
He tasted death for everyone
Not ashamed to call them brothers

questions.q: The chapter says Jesus delivers those who were held in bondage all their lives by fear of death.
The chapter says we already see all things subjected to him.
Jesus is compared with which faithful servant of God in this chapter?
Why is Jesus counted worthy of more glory than Moses?
options: The builder has more honor than the house
He spoke with God face to face

questions.q: For how long did the fathers test God and see his deeds in the wilderness?
In what role was Moses faithful in all God's house?
Today if you will hear his voice, ____ as in the rebellion.
Exhort one another day by day, lest any one of you be hardened by ____.
Holy brothers, consider the Apostle and ____ of our confession: Jesus.

items: Christ is faithful as a Son over his house
Don't harden your hearts as in the rebellion
Beware of an evil heart of unbelief
Those who came out of Egypt rebelled

questions.q: The chapter says the Israelites could not enter God's rest because of unbelief.
The chapter says those who rebelled were people who had stayed behind in Egypt.
What is the word of God said to be sharper than?
Why didn't the word profit those who heard it in the past?
options: It came to them too late

questions.q: Which leader is said not to have given the people rest?
Through whom does God speak of another day called today, long afterward?
There remains therefore ____ for the people of God.
But one who has been in all points tempted like we are, ____.
Piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, ____, and able to discern the thoughts of the heart.

items: Fear lest we come short of his rest
Give diligence to enter that rest
Hold tightly to our confession
Draw near to the throne of grace

questions.q: The chapter says no creature is hidden from God's sight.
The chapter describes Jesus as a high priest who remained on earth rather than passing through the heavens.
After whose order is Christ named a high priest?
Who is given as an example of a high priest called by God?
Why can an earthly high priest deal gently with the ignorant?
options: He himself is surrounded with weakness
He was chosen by the people

questions.q: How did Christ offer up prayers in the days of his flesh?
You have come to need milk, and ____.
Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him ____.
Solid food is for the full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised ____.

items: Every high priest is taken from among men
You are a priest forever
He learned obedience by what he suffered
You have become dull of hearing

questions.q: The chapter says Christ took the honor of being high priest on himself.
The writer says that by this time the readers should be teachers.
What does the writer urge readers to press on to?
By whom did God swear when he made his promise to Abraham?
What happens to land that bears thorns and thistles?
options: It is rejected, and its end is to be burned
It is left to rest for seven years
It is given to another farmer
It is watered until it bears fruit

questions.q: Which is NOT among the foundational teachings the writer wants to move past?
This hope we have as ____, a hope both sure and steadfast.
God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and ____ which you showed toward his name.
That by two immutable things, in which it is impossible ____, we may have a strong encouragement.

items: Those who fell away cannot be renewed
Land that bears a good crop is blessed
Show diligence to the fullness of hope
Jesus entered as a forerunner for us

questions.q: The chapter says Abraham obtained the promise after he had patiently endured.
The chapter says Jesus became a high priest forever after the order of Aaron.
What did Abraham give to Melchizedek?
options: A tenth of the best plunder

questions.q: From which tribe did our Lord spring?
Why were there many priests under the old priesthood?
By interpretation, what does the name Melchizedek mean?
You are a priest forever, according to ____.
By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of ____.
Who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after ____.
questions.answer: the power of an endless life

items: Melchizedek met Abraham and blessed him
The lesser is blessed by the greater
The law made nothing perfect
He lives forever to make intercession

questions.q: The chapter says Jesus must offer sacrifices daily, first for his own sins.
The chapter describes Melchizedek as without father, without mother, and without genealogy.
What does the Lord say he will make with the house of Israel and Judah?
What do the earthly priests serve, according to the chapter?
options: A copy and shadow of heavenly things
The true tabernacle of the Lord

questions.q: What does God say he will do with his laws under the new covenant?
options: Put them in their mind, write them on hearts
Carve them on new tablets of stone
Read them aloud to every nation
Give them to the priests to teach

questions.q: Why would Jesus not be a priest at all if he were on earth?
options: There are already priests offering gifts by the law
He never entered the temple courts
He had no sacrifice to offer

questions.q: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and ____ no more.
See, you shall make everything according to ____ that was shown to you on the mountain.
That which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is ____.

items: The main point: we have such a high priest
If the first covenant had been faultless
All will know me, least to greatest
A new covenant makes the first obsolete

questions.q: The chapter says Jesus is the mediator of a better covenant given on better promises.
The chapter says God found no fault with the people under the first covenant.
How often did the high priest enter the second part of the tabernacle?
What was inside the ark of the covenant?
options: The manna pot, Aaron's rod, and the tablets
The lamp stand, the table, and the bread
The altar of incense and the oil
A scroll of the law and a crown

questions.q: Through whose blood did Christ enter the Holy Place once for all?
options: The blood of goats and calves
The blood of a spotless lamb

questions.q: What did Moses sprinkle with blood after speaking every commandment?
options: The book itself and all the people

questions.q: It is appointed for men to die once, and ____.
Nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood ____.
How much more will the blood of Christ cleanse your conscience from ____ to serve the living God?

items: The earthly tabernacle and its furnishings
Gifts could not perfect the worshiper's conscience
A will is in force only after death
Christ will appear a second time

questions.q: The chapter says Christ entered into holy places made with hands.
The chapter says even the first covenant was not dedicated without blood.
What can the blood of bulls and goats never do?
What does the writer tell readers not to forsake?
What had the readers joyfully accepted in former days?
How is the new and living way into the holy place described?
options: Through the veil, that is, his flesh
Through the gate of the temple
Up the steps of the altar

questions.q: It is a fearful thing to fall into ____.
questions.answer: the hands of the living God

questions.q: Let's consider how to provoke one another to ____.
But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, ____ in him.

items: The law is a shadow of good things
I have come to do your will
The Holy Spirit testifies of the covenant
Hold fast the confession of our hope

The chapter says that for one who sins willfully after knowing the truth, a sacrifice for sins still remains.
Who by faith prepared a ship for the saving of his house?
Who by faith was taken away so that he wouldn't see death?
How long was Moses hidden by his parents after he was born?
Who is NOT named among those the writer lacks time to tell about?
Without faith it is impossible ____.
questions.answer: to be well pleasing to him

questions.q: For he was looking for ____, whose builder and maker is God.
wrong: a kingdom not made with hands

questions.q: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled ____.

items: Abel offered a more excellent sacrifice
Abraham went out not knowing where
Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau
Rahab received the spies in peace

questions.q: The chapter says Abraham offered up Isaac, concluding that God could raise him from the dead.
The chapter says Moses left Egypt because he feared the king's wrath.
What does the writer say we are surrounded by?
options: So great a cloud of witnesses

questions.q: What did Esau sell his birthright for?
How does the chapter end by describing our God?
What did Moses say because the sight at the mountain was so fearful?
options: Woe is me, for I am undone

questions.q: Looking to Jesus, ____, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross.
questions.answer: the author and perfecter of faith

questions.q: All chastening seems grievous for the present; yet afterward it yields ____.
Lest any ____ springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it.

items: Run with perseverance the race set before us
The Lord disciplines the one he loves
Lift up the hands that hang down
You have come to Mount Zion

The chapter says believers are receiving a Kingdom that can't be shaken.
What have some done by showing hospitality to strangers?
Where did Jesus suffer so that he might sanctify the people?
Who does the writer say has been freed?
Who send greetings at the close of the letter?
Jesus Christ is ____.
questions.answer: the same yesterday, today, and forever

questions.q: Through him, then, let's offer up ____ to God continually.
For we don't have here an enduring city, but we seek ____.

items: Let brotherly love continue
Let marriage be held in honor
Be free from the love of money
Remember your leaders

The writer says it is good for the heart to be established by foods rather than by grace.
